issue.title: [BUG]: Recording endpoint remains "Currently unavailable" in mmsys.cpl when selected through a KSNODETYPE_MUX topology

findings.detail: No recognized build manifest found; the build procedure needs review. Resolved for this revision: The pinned branch contains the ACX driver solution and documents MSBuild from a Visual Studio 2022 developer prompt; only the UAC2 driver solution is relevant to this repair and does not use the separately licensed ASIO SDK.

limitations: READY_TO_INVESTIGATE means metadata is sufficient to begin engineering review, not a reproduced or repaired bug.
Dependency manifests are scanned heuristically; transitive dependencies, availability of registry packages, native libraries and physical equipment are not verified.
Only explicit PR references are matched; semantically related work without links can be missed.

dimensions.reason: The selected input looks unavailable and has no meter even though capture works.
The complete report was filed today.
The reporter tested two machines, two USB devices and named the exact branch revision.
Endpoints without connector detection must be static and remain available.
The issue is stable on two architectures; a source regression verifies the incorrect jack capability before live validation.
One dummy-jack configuration removes an invalid capability and callback.
Source evidence is cheap, while final confirmation requires a Windows driver build and physical USB device.
Physical connector-controlled jacks retain detection; only the no-control dummy path becomes static.
The yamaha-main branch and issue are current.
The path applies across USB Audio 2 selector devices, including Sound Blaster G3 and VID 147A PID E055.
All endpoints without connector control share the corrected static-jack configuration.
Correct availability restores mmsys.cpl state and the endpoint level meter for the selected hardware input.
